# Scene An Unexpected Phone Call

The road outside the tea stall, evening.

Anudi stands in the rain. Her phone rings. The caller ID reads "Thaththe". She puts down her handbag and answers.

**FATHER (ON THE PHONE)**

*(Quietly)*

Come home soon. We need to talk.

**ANUDI**

*(Nervous)*

I am on my way, Thaththe.

**FATHER (ON THE PHONE)**

*(Firmly)*

Do not be late.

She hangs up and looks at the café across the road.
